name: 995.library
description: Deterministic Local Curses Cockpit & Library Architecture

scripts.check:boundary: node -e "const s = require('child_process').execSync('git status -s apps/995.library/995.library/').toString().trim(); if (s) { console.error('BOUNDARY BREACH:', s); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.check:sentry: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { const out = execSync('git grep -n -P \"[\\\\x{1F300}-\\\\x{1FAD6}]\" packages/ apps/995.library/run.ts .github/', { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim(); if (out) { console.error(':: [FAIL] UTF-8 emojis detected:\\n', out); process.exit(1); } } catch (e) { process.exit(0); }"
scripts.check:artifacts: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); function scan(d) { for (const e of fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true })) { const p = path.join(d, e.name); if (e.isDirectory() && e.name !== 'node_modules' && e.name !== 'dist') scan(p); else if (e.isFile() && (e.name.endsWith('.js') || e.name.endsWith('.d.ts')) && !e.name.includes('.config.')) { console.error(':: [FAIL] Leaked artifact in source:', p); process.exit(1); } } } scan('packages/000.agent');"
scripts.check:all: npm run check:boundary && npm run check:sentry && npm run check:artifacts && npm run check:types && npm run prettier:check && npm run lint:check
scripts.test: npm run test:agent && npm run test:library
scripts.fix:all: npm run prettier:fix && npm run lint:fix
scripts.clean: npm run clean:dist && npm run clean:ts
scripts.reset: npm run clean && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install && npm run build
